theorems.name: Submission.idtp_fons_cc_tm_density_homogeneous
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)), (∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → ∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → ν ((fun x => lam • x) '' A) = ENNReal.ofReal (lam ^ n) * ν A) → ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∀ w : Euclid P, limsup (fun ρ : ℝ => ν (ball (t • w) ρ) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0) = limsup (fun ρ : ℝ => ν (ball w ρ) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
